checks.finding: 36 fixed variants x SPY/QQQ classifications x three groups; no return ranking or return-based branch
Target net returns use payoff diagnostics; matched excess uses plain descriptive moments and explicitly is not target profit
No 40-percent or other win-rate acceptance gate in analyze_relative or return_distribution
Null net/excess stays missing; no fill-to-zero; unknown classification is retained as its own group
Complete outcomes averaged within date; empty date has no return observation
not_down-minus-down uses matched excess means only on dates where both groups exist; down-only/not-down-only/neither preserved
Primary intervals sample equally weighted date means with replacement; fixed label-derived seeds and 2000 draws; fewer than two dates yields no interval
Uses full calendar; zero/missing breaks runs; labels calendar-adjacent date means, not trade losing streak/account drawdown
All supplied positive/negative/zero target returns remain in main statistics; top/worst tail removal is separately retrospective
Production main verifies frozen source and parent hashes, classification file hash, case identity, exact 36-variant masks and fixed counts
Production main performs offline local file processing; no order, funding, API, or scheduler path

limits: Static review does not validate empirical outputs or classification source causality; other audits cover those.
Microbenchmark uses synthetic data only and is not a production performance guarantee.
Daily output has counts and means; full payoff diagnostics are all-period/month/H1/H2, not repeated daily.
No assertion of strategy advantage, unseen H2 validation, or implementable options/portfolio results.
